name: University of Pécs
summary: Pécs university with 10 faculties; over 40 bachelor's and long-cycle degrees in English, from medicine and pharmacy to engineering, arts and music.

ib.text: The full IB Diploma is required (single certificates are not accepted) and exempts from the English test, though Medical, Pharmacy, Health and Engineering applicants are still tested. No IB exemption from medical exams.

Application deadline: business administration, pre-school teaching

Application deadline: all other degrees listed (autumn 2027)

Medical School entrance exams: last Wednesday exam day

programmes.name: General Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year medical degree in English at the Medical School: basic and pre-clinical modules, a clinical core, then a year of clinical rotations.
programmes.overview: The six-year medical degree runs in three stages. A basic module covers the structure and function of the healthy body through anatomy, histology, embryology and biochemistry; a preclinical module turns to pathology, microbiology and patient examination skills; and the clinical module teaches specific diseases and their diagnosis and treatment, mostly in the hospital wards. Direct experience with patients at the bedside or in the operating theatre is central, and the final year is a full practical year in the wards, where students carry out medical work under supervision. Clinical areas include cardiology, paediatrics, neurology, psychiatry, surgery, obstetrics and oncology.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma gives no exemption from the entrance exam; grades in chemistry, physics and biology should be as high as possible, and the exam (written and oral) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Complex written and oral entrance exam (online possible, USD 250); admission rests solely on your performance in it. Exams run every Wednesday, 3 March-14 July 2027.

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year dental degree in English at the Medical School, joining basic and clinical science from the first years and ending in the DMD title.
programmes.overview: The first two years cover physics, chemistry, biochemistry, cell biology, anatomy, histology, general and oral microbiology, pathology and behavioural sciences. A preclinical stage follows, with internal medicine, surgery, dental pre-clinics, diagnostic imaging and pharmacology, and then intensive clinical study of each discipline of dentistry, including preventive dentistry, oral surgery, restorative dentistry with implants, paediatric dentistry and orthodontics. The aim is to unify basic and clinical sciences so that theory and practice develop together, with hospital-based placements and clinical conferences.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma gives no exemption from the entrance exam; grades in chemistry, physics and biology should be as high as possible, and the exam (written and oral) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Complex written and oral entrance exam (online possible, USD 250); admission rests solely on your performance in it. Exams run every Wednesday, 3 March-14 July 2027.

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier pharmacy degree in English (10 semesters): basic sciences first, then pharmacy teaching and hospital placements, industry and research.
programmes.overview: The five-year course starts with the basic sciences that underpin pharmaceutical studies, then moves to general and specialised pharmaceutical education in university departments, teaching pharmacies, institutes, laboratories and the pharmaceutical industry. A fast-track route is open to people who already hold a pharmacy BSc, and a combined Pharmacy and Biotechnology pathway is available. Graduates work in public and hospital pharmacies, laboratories, the pharmaceutical industry, research institutes, the international trade in medicines and the management of pharmaceutical materials.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test only in general; an oral entrance exam interview decides, and the Faculty tests your English as well.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam interview, online possible (USD 250 exam fee); the Faculty asks for the best grades in chemistry, physics and biology.

programmes.name: Accelerated Pharmacy-Biotechnology Degree Pathway
programmes.about: Combined pharmacy and biotechnology path in English over 5+1 years (12 semesters), with laboratory training and projects aimed at drug development and biopharma production.
programmes.overview: Pharmacy and biotechnology courses are combined from the start, so two qualifications, a Doctor of Pharmacy and a biotechnologist BSc, are earned in six years rather than eight. The foundation covers physics, general, inorganic, organic and analytical chemistry and biostatistics, followed by cell biology, biochemistry, microbiology, genetics and bioinformatics, and then molecular biology, gene technology, pharmaceutical, medical and environmental biotechnology, quality assurance and data science. Training uses fully equipped student laboratories and research projects. Graduates move into pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, regulatory agencies, advanced research or doctoral study.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test only in general; an oral entrance exam interview decides, and the Faculty tests your English as well.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam interview (online possible); years 1-5 cost €8,400 a year, the 6th year €7,000.

programmes.name: Architecture (BSc + MSc)
programmes.credential: Master of Science in Architecture (5 years)
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier architecture degree in English covering design, town and country planning, heritage, structures and building management.
programmes.overview: This is an integrated five-year degree. The first five or six semesters lay groundwork in both the artistic and the engineering sides of architecture: design studios, building construction, materials, structural mechanics, art history, digital architecture, architectural drawing, construction technology and energy systems. Later semesters add ecodesign, urban planning, heritage protection, interior spaces and architectural theory, ending in a complex design project and a thesis. Graduates work in architectural design, town and country planning, heritage preservation, structural design, construction, consulting for authorities and teaching, or continue to doctoral study.
programmes.ib: Portfolio of creative work and an online interview are scored; IB Diploma exempts from the English test but Engineering still tests English.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100: school grades 30, motivation letter 15, portfolio 15, online interview 40; a C1 certificate and a reference add up to 10 more.

programmes.name: Graphic Artist Specialising in Graphic Design
programmes.credential: Master of Arts, Graphic Artist (5 years)
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier art degree in English training graphic artists in drawing-based graphic genres, from study drawing to professional graphic design.
programmes.overview: This five-year integrated course, ending in a master's-level qualification, trains artists to work in drawing-based graphic genres. You become familiar with the artistic traditions and outstanding works of contemporary art, and with the means of expression, materials and techniques of graphic art in general. The focus is on the artist's own creative practice in the graphic arts. Graduates have the knowledge needed to continue their studies at doctoral level.
programmes.ib: Portfolio of at least 10 works and an online interview with aptitude test decide; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of at least 10 works from the past 2-3 years (including a nude drawing) and an online interview combined with an aptitude test.

programmes.name: Painting
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier painting degree in English building from drawing and basic painting techniques towards a personal artistic practice.
programmes.overview: A five-year integrated course leading to a master's in painting, taught in the studio. The early years teach the basic rudiments and techniques of painting, with drawing as the foundation, and the work gradually moves toward independent artistic practice. You develop drawing skills, image-making methods, colour, form and spatial composition, and learn art history and contemporary art, while working in drawing, painting and collage. The aim is a personal way of observing, thinking and representing the world, preparing for a career in art.
programmes.ib: Portfolio of at least 10 works and an online interview with aptitude test decide; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of at least 10 works in varied techniques, preferably colour drawings and paintings from the past 2-3 years, plus an online interview and aptitude test.

programmes.name: Sculpture
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier sculpture degree in English training sculptors who work with materials, techniques and the expressive means of sculpture.
programmes.overview: A five-year integrated course leading to a master's in sculpture, built on studio work and practical skill development. You learn sculptural materials and techniques, professional drawing and modelling, and develop spatial perception, a sense of proportion, and control of colour and shape, grounded in both modern and classical foundations, alongside art history and contemporary art. Graduates are prepared to work as visual artists in professional sculptural practice and to move on to doctoral training.
programmes.ib: Portfolio and an online interview with aptitude test decide; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry through a portfolio, an online interview and an aptitude test; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.

programmes.name: Archaeology
programmes.about: Three-year archaeology degree in English on the theory and methods of the field and two chosen specialisations, opening work on excavations and in museums and research.
programmes.overview: You study archaeology across periods (migration, medieval and early modern, Roman, classical and Byzantine), together with Latin basics, research methods, philosophy, art history, museology and the analysis of find material. Fieldwork is mandatory: excavation practice in the first and fifth semesters, archaeological survey in the fourth and museum education practice in the sixth, in collaboration with outside institutions, and the degree ends with a thesis. Teaching uses lectures, seminars, individual tuition and group projects, and Erasmus exchanges are open. Graduates work as excavation technicians, museum collection managers or in research groups and heritage institutions, or go on to the archaeology master's.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; an entrance exam, a motivation letter and video are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam (in person or MS Teams), motivation letter of 3,000-3,500 characters and a motivation video; English test (or IB Diploma) and a minimum school GPA.

programmes.name: Liberal Arts
programmes.about: Three-year multidisciplinary humanities BA in English (majors: art history, classical studies, ethics, film and visual studies) where you build your own programme around majors such as art history, classical studies, film and visual studies, or philosophy.
programmes.overview: You choose one major and one minor from Art History, Classical Studies, Film and Visual Studies and Philosophy, plus core courses, so no two students follow exactly the same path. The first year includes academic writing and an introduction to European cultural history, followed by subject courses such as Romanesque and Gothic art, ancient philosophy and film history. Classes are small interactive seminar groups built around discussion and debate, developing critical thinking and written and oral communication. Graduates continue to graduate study or work in museums, libraries, galleries, film studios, media, publishing, education and non-profits.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; a 10-15 minute online interview and a motivation letter are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview of 10-15 minutes on motivation and interests, a motivation letter of 3,000-3,500 characters and a video; English test or IB Diploma exemption.

programmes.name: Communication and Media Science
programmes.about: Three-year degree in English with a Digital Media and Public Relations specialisation: journalism, PR, advertising and organisational communication, with hands-on media production.
programmes.overview: The course covers social communication theory, media studies, cultural anthropology, interpersonal communication and empirical research methods, with practical training in visual communication, photo and video production and multimedia. Specialised topics include the network society, social media and youth cultures, organisational communication, journalism practice, marketing and PR, and the legal and ethical side of communication regulation. A Digital Media and Public Relations specialisation prepares you for journalism and PR work. Graduates work as journalists, editors and content producers, or as communication experts in companies, state bodies and NGOs.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; an entrance exam, a motivation letter and video are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam (in person or MS Teams), motivation letter and video; English test (or IB Diploma) and a minimum school GPA.

programmes.name: English and American Studies
programmes.about: Three-year BA in English on the language, literatures and cultures of English-speaking peoples, with inter- and multi-disciplinary approaches.
programmes.overview: The course combines language development, linguistics and literary analysis with the history and culture of English-speaking countries, including the history of the United Kingdom and the United States and the history of philosophy. Later modules cover British and American literature, contemporary societies and applied linguistics. Teaching is inter- and multi-disciplinary, mixing theory with practice, and you build research techniques and skills in translating non-specialised texts. Graduates are prepared for roles in mass communication, media and tourism and for postgraduate study.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; an entrance exam, a motivation letter and video are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam (in person or MS Teams), motivation letter and video; English test (or IB Diploma) and a minimum school GPA.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Interdisciplinary three-year politics and social-science degree in English, with courses on global issues, developing countries, Asia and European and Central Eastern European affairs.
programmes.overview: Core courses include introduction to international relations, diplomacy and negotiation techniques, comparative politics, international and political law, political geography, European integration and EU policies, international economics, globalisation, security and migration policy and twentieth-century world history. Teaching draws on the Faculties of Humanities, Business and Economics, and Law, and mixes theory with practice, including an International Studies in Practice course in semester five. Graduates work in the NGO sector, international organisations, diplomacy, political analysis, journalism and ministries.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; a 10-15 minute online interview and a motivation letter are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview of 10-15 minutes on motivation and interests, a motivation letter of 3,000-3,500 characters and a video; English test or IB Diploma exemption.

programmes.name: Pedagogy (Intercultural Educational Assistant)
programmes.about: Three-year pedagogy degree in English with an intercultural educational assistant specialisation, opening work in community education, counselling and educational policy.
programmes.overview: The course covers learning-centred communication, education systems, comparative education, developmental and educational psychology with practical components, and an intercultural focus: minority education policy in Europe, inclusive education, integration and segregation, and special education cases. Project management, critical thinking and an academic English module support this, and a counselling practical course in the sixth semester gives hands-on experience. Teaching is by lectures, seminars, group work and small research projects. Graduates work as education programme coordinators, international student coordinators, community relations assistants or in refugee education, or continue to teaching at master's level.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; a 10-15 minute online interview and a motivation letter are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Online interview of 10-15 minutes on motivation and interests, a motivation letter of 3,000-3,500 characters and a video; English test or IB Diploma exemption.

programmes.name: Pre-school Teaching
programmes.about: Three-year degree in English training teachers for children aged 3 to 7, with practice from the first semester and a wide choice of optional modules.
programmes.overview: The course covers introductory and developmental psychology, pedagogy, and the methods of teaching physical education, mathematics, music and visual education, plus children's literature, games in pre-school, environmental education, cultural diversity in texts, family education and family and children's law. Practice sessions are built in from the first semester and recur in semesters one, three, four and five, mixing traditional and alternative methods with child-centred approaches. Optional modules allow some choice. Graduates are prepared to teach children aged three to seven in pre-school settings.
programmes.ib: School-leaving certificate and documents are assessed; IB Diploma exempts from the English test.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your school certificate and documents; the Faculty of Cultural Sciences does not describe an exam.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Three-year psychology BA in English linking the biological and social sciences with the humanities, preparing for specialised study or many careers.
programmes.overview: The core covers social psychology, cognitive psychology (attention, memory, thinking), evolutionary and developmental psychology and neurology, with supporting subjects in biology, human genetics, psychometrics and personality. Applied areas include health, work and organisational, school and arts psychology. The programme builds skills in experimental science, statistical analysis, research and communication. Graduates can move toward clinical, counselling, educational, forensic, health or occupational psychology.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; an entrance exam, a motivation letter and video are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam (in person or MS Teams), motivation letter and video; English test (or IB Diploma) and a school GPA of about 70% or better.

programmes.name: Romology (Roma Studies)
programmes.about: Three-year degree in English training experts in Roma studies, with a Boyash or Romani language-and-culture specialisation, to work with Roma communities and organisations.
programmes.overview: The course trains experts who can communicate Roma community issues to government and non-governmental bodies. You study social studies, the history of the Roma, contemporary Roma art, music and literature, sociolinguistics, ethnography and cultural anthropology, using cooperative learning, group work, fieldwork and research methods. After the first semester you choose a specialisation in Boyash or Romani language and culture, working toward B2 proficiency in that language. Interdisciplinary work with sociologists, teachers, lawyers and doctors prepares graduates for jobs in education, social issues and minority rights.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; an entrance exam, a motivation letter and video are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam (in person or MS Teams), motivation letter and video; English test (or IB Diploma) and a minimum school GPA.

programmes.name: Social Work
programmes.about: Seven-semester social work degree in English on social systems, human behaviour and social justice, with theory and practice modules.
programmes.overview: You study the theory and practice of social work, social policy, sociology, economics, social law, psychology, public health and education, with an emphasis on critical-reflective thinking, strengths-based approaches and professional ethics rooted in social justice. Coursework includes empirical research methods, human development across the lifespan, family consultation, group and community work, addiction studies, child protection and an introduction to counselling, alongside professional skills training. The entire seventh semester is intensive field practice in a placement chosen according to your interests and institutional availability.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; an entrance exam and a motivation letter are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam (in person or via Skype), motivation letter and video; English test or IB Diploma exemption. The autumn 2027 intake closes 30 June.

programmes.name: Business Administration and Management
programmes.about: EFMD-accredited seven-semester business degree in English taught with cases, practical tasks, teamwork and guest lecturers, with optional modules in marketing, management or finance.
programmes.overview: Mandatory courses cover quantitative methods, microeconomics and macroeconomics, organisational behaviour, corporate finance, accounting, marketing, human resources and international business, with business case studies and operations management in later semesters. Teaching mixes lectures with case studies, practical tasks and teamwork, and guest lecturers from Europe and the United States bring real-world business practice. Optional modules let you deepen a field such as marketing, management or finance. The degree carries EFMD accreditation and prepares you for a business career.
programmes.ib: Maths test counts (no IB exemption is published); IB Diploma exempts from the English test.
programmes.selectionNote: Document points, an online maths test (0-10, at least 50% to pass) and a 10-minute online committee interview about your background and motivation.

programmes.name: Architectural Engineering
programmes.about: Seven-semester degree in English on engineering design, structures and construction management, built around the architect's responsibility for building design and team work.
programmes.overview: You study design studios, architectural drawing, building construction and materials, strength of materials, digital architecture and CAD, architectural history and theory, energy systems, ecodesign, urban planning and professional practice. Teaching combines lectures, workshops and studio work, including perspective drawing, computer graphics and model building, with live projects and case studies, and stresses the architect's responsibility, the detailed development of building systems and teamwork with other design and engineering professionals. The degree ends with a graduation studio, and graduates can continue to a master's within the same faculty.
programmes.ib: Portfolio of creative work and an online interview are scored; IB Diploma exempts from the English test but Engineering still tests English.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100: school grades 30, motivation letter 15, portfolio 15, online interview 40; a C1 certificate and a reference add up to 10 more.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Eight-semester degree in English on large structures, building and infrastructure engineering, plus computers, economics and communication skills.
programmes.overview: The course covers large structures, building engineering, infrastructure such as bridges and highways, and municipal water and wastewater systems. Core modules include materials science, fluid mechanics, structural analysis, reinforced concrete, timber and masonry, steel-composite structures, hydraulics and environmental protection, built on mathematics, natural sciences and economics, with computer and communication skills. Field practice in geodesy and hydrology and diagnostic practicals are part of the study plan, and the final semester is a BSc thesis. Most graduates work in planning, design or management, including construction, structural engineering, transport and urban planning.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but engineering still tests English by online test or interview; a motivation letter and online interview are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100: school grades 40, motivation letter 20, online interview 40 (at least 60 to pass); a C1 certificate and a reference add up to 10. Lists 2027/28 criteria.

programmes.name: Computer Science Engineering
programmes.about: Seven-semester engineering-side computing degree in English on software engineering, networks and information systems, with much laboratory work and project experience.
programmes.overview: Much of the study is laboratory-oriented, and internships let you study and work at the same time. Subjects include programming at several levels, algorithms, electrical engineering foundations, system theory, web and visual programming, operating systems, software technology, information security and project management, moving from fundamentals through intermediate applications to specialisation. The Application Developer specialisation is offered, and the seventh semester is a thesis combined with a capstone programming project. The course suits practice-oriented students and prepares them for IT engineering teams.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but engineering still tests English by online test or interview; a motivation letter and online interview are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100: school grades 40, motivation letter 20, online interview 40 (at least 60 to pass); a C1 certificate and a reference add up to 10. Lists 2027/28 criteria.

separateFrom.name: Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: Different faculty and degree: engineering rather than science, USD fees, scored on grades, letter and interview rather than a maths test.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Seven-semester practical mechanical engineering degree in English for the built environment and industry, with planning, industrial management and systems engineering modules.
programmes.overview: The course covers fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, strength of materials, machine elements, structural materials, machining, electrical and control engineering, welding, robotics and flexible manufacturing systems, within a systems view of mechanical, mechatronic and electronic aspects, plus planning and industrial management. Emphasis falls on simulation of engineering systems, numerical modelling, quality control, innovation techniques and polymer and additive technologies. Learning uses laboratory work, projects and field practice at one of the Institute of Mechanical Engineering's industrial partners, and the faculty's international contacts allow study abroad.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but engineering still tests English by online test or interview; a motivation letter and online interview are scored.
programmes.selectionNote: Scored out of 100: school grades 40, motivation letter 20, online interview 40 (at least 60 to pass); a C1 certificate and a reference add up to 10. Lists 2027/28 criteria.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Seven-semester degree in English in designing, making and operating electrical and electronic equipment, with measurement and control tasks.
programmes.overview: The course prepares electrical and electronic engineers for the design, manufacture and operation of electrical and electronic appliances, equipment and facilities. You build competence in measurement, evaluation, control and management on a base of electrical and electronic engineering theory and its applications. Students are drawn into complex projects and developments already during their university years.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but engineering still tests English by online test or interview.
programmes.selectionNote: The portal page lists a motivation letter only; Pécs's other engineering degrees also score grades and an online interview, so ask the Faculty.

programmes.name: Biology
programmes.about: Three-year biology degree in English with neurobiology, genetics, microbiology, ecology, botany and zoology, and a choice between lab-based and ecology-based modules.
programmes.overview: The degree gives a full grounding in biology, with strengths in neurobiology, genetics, microbiology, animal and plant ecology, botany, zoology and plant physiology. The first four semesters cover cell biology, comparative anatomy, plant taxonomy, biochemistry and microbiology. In year two you choose an infra-individual module, with laboratory and cellular biology, or a supra-individual module, with ecology, each mixing lectures, seminars and practicals. Laboratory practices and a botanical and zoological field practice are included, and students can use modern instruments in the Szentagothai Research Centre and join one of its research groups.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; no IB subject or exam is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your school transcripts, a 3,000-3,500 character motivation letter and B2 English (certificate or IB Diploma); no entrance exam is described.

programmes.name: Biotechnology
programmes.about: Three-year biotechnology degree in English from the Faculty of Pharmacy: basic sciences first, then biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology and lab placements in industry or research.
programmes.overview: The first eighteen months cover general, inorganic, organic, analytical and physical chemistry, physics and biophysics. Later you study biochemistry, microbiology, genetics, molecular biology, genetic manipulation and immunology, with applications in pharmaceutical, medical, food and environmental biotechnology, plus biostatistics and data management. Teaching offers hands-on work with laboratory techniques. Six weeks of practical training in industry or research laboratories fall in semesters five and six, and a written thesis closes the degree. Graduates work in industrial testing, pharmaceutical R&D, production, contract research and bioanalytics, or continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: An oral entrance exam interview decides; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam interview (online possible); application fee waived, USD 250 exam fee.

programmes.name: Chemistry
programmes.about: Three-year chemistry degree in English with inorganic, organic, analytical, environmental and physical chemistry, instrumental analysis and maths.
programmes.overview: The degree gives a full education in chemistry, with directions in inorganic and organic, analytical and environmental, and physical chemistry. Year one builds foundational chemistry and physics, and later courses include chemometrics, theoretical and quantum chemistry, biochemistry, instrumental analysis, advanced organic chemistry, environmental and colloid chemistry and physical chemistry measurements. Teaching combines lectures, seminars with discussion and chemical calculations, and laboratory work with modern instruments, and electives support deeper study in a chosen area.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; no IB subject or exam is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your school transcripts, a 3,000-3,500 character motivation letter and B2 English (certificate or IB Diploma); no entrance exam is described.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Three-year computer science degree in English on programming, discrete mathematics, calculus, software technology and systems, for coding work or master's study.
programmes.overview: First-year courses cover discrete mathematics, calculus, linear algebra, computer architecture, algorithms, data structures and software technology; later semesters add formal languages, database design, systems design, programming languages and networking. After the fundamentals you choose an Academic track, centred on applied and theoretical mathematics, operations research and algorithm theory, or an Applied track, centred on software development technologies, with room for electives. The final year includes thesis preparation. Graduates work as coders and software developers in the IT sector or continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: A 45-minute online maths test and then an oral exam decide; no IB exemption is published.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths test on Moodle (45 minutes) must be passed, then an oral exam on English, maths and informatics; motivation letter and B2 English also needed.

separateFrom.name: Computer Science Engineering
separateFrom.reason: Different faculty and degree: science rather than engineering, EUR fees, a maths test and oral exam instead of the points interview.

programmes.name: Earth Sciences
programmes.about: Three-year earth sciences degree in English with an optional geology specialisation, covering geomorphology, geophysics, hydrology, meteorology and remote sensing.
programmes.overview: The degree gives a general grounding in earth sciences with a strong regional geographical outlook and the option to specialise in geology. Subjects include astronomy, cartography, geomorphology, geophysics, geochemistry, hydrology, meteorology, palaeontology, palaeoclimatology, remote sensing and stratigraphy, plus human geography. Early courses introduce biogeography, meteorology and astronomical geography, the middle semesters move to structural geology and petrographic microscopy, and later ones to engineering geology, geoparks and geotourism and economic geology.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; no IB subject or exam is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your school transcripts, a 3,000-3,500 character motivation letter and B2 English (certificate or IB Diploma); no entrance exam is described.

programmes.name: Geography
programmes.about: Three-year geography degree in English with directions in landscape and environment, regional development or tourism, each built on a GIS foundation.
programmes.overview: Early semesters cover human geography, planetology and basic natural sciences, then physical geography (geomorphology, climatology, biogeography), human geography (population, settlement, political geography) and regional studies, with a strong GIS basis throughout. Courses usually pair a lecture with a problem-solving seminar. You can concentrate on Environmental Geography, Regional and Urban Development or Tourism Geography. The degree leads on to the university's master's in applied geography, which offers a geomorphology and GIS specialisation.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; no IB subject or exam is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your school transcripts, a 3,000-3,500 character motivation letter and B2 English (certificate or IB Diploma); no entrance exam is described.

programmes.name: Mathematics
programmes.about: Three-year mathematics degree in English: logic, algebra, number theory, calculus, geometry, probability and game theory, feeding into applied mathematics and operations research.
programmes.overview: Foundations include logic, computer science, linear algebra, number theory, calculus, geometry, probability, statistics and game theory. Advanced courses cover mathematical programming, operations research, group theory, computer algebra, numerical methods and applied computer science. Most courses pair lectures with problem-solving seminars. The degree is a base for further study in mathematics or computer science, and leads directly to the university's master's in applied mathematics, which stresses operations research, or to master's programmes elsewhere.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; no IB subject or exam is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: The portal page asks for a motivation letter and intermediate English; it describes no entrance exam.

programmes.name: Physical Training
programmes.about: Three-year coaching degree in English with modules in team and individual sports, sport medicine, social aspects and sport sciences; you choose one sport specialisation.
programmes.overview: The course is built from five modules: team and individual sports, medical aspects of sport, social aspects of sport, sport sciences and professional practice. Year one covers psychology, anatomy and sport theory; year two training leadership, physiology, biomechanics and sport psychology; and year three sport management, performance testing, rehabilitation and a thesis. Teaching mixes lectures, seminars, practicals and lab work, with an internship every semester that moves from observing to leading training sessions. You choose a sport such as athletics, handball, basketball, football, swimming or fencing. Graduates work as personal trainers and coaches, or continue to a master's in recreation, coaching or adapted physical education.
programmes.ib: Good grades in biology and PE are expected, and a Skype interview decides; IB Diploma exempts from the English test.
programmes.selectionNote: Skype interview on anatomy, physiology and your sport and school background; good school grades in biology and PE are expected.

programmes.name: Physics
programmes.about: Three-year physics degree in English with common maths, physics and informatics courses, then applied physics or informatics in physics.
programmes.overview: After introductory natural sciences and a common core in mathematics, physics and informatics (mechanics, thermodynamics, waves, optics, electricity and magnetism, modern and quantum physics), you specialise in Applied Physics, with advanced experimental and theoretical work, or in Informatics in Physics, covering data acquisition, signal processing in LabView, database management and programming in C#. Teaching includes lectures, laboratories such as CAD and optical measurement, and programming courses in MATLAB and C#, using modern instrumentation.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test; no IB subject or exam is asked.
programmes.selectionNote: Decided on your school transcripts, a 3,000-3,500 character motivation letter and B2 English (certificate or IB Diploma); no entrance exam is described.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.about: Four-year nursing degree in English on prevention, treatment, nursing and rehabilitation at each level of health and social care, with hospital and community practice.
programmes.overview: The course trains nurses for prevention, treatment, nursing and rehabilitation across health and social care, covering individual, family, community and public health. You study anatomy, pathology and the causes, symptoms, treatment and prevention of illness, and subjects such as basic health care, internal medicine, paediatrics, geriatrics, surgery, obstetrics, community and chronic disease nursing, anaesthesiology, intensive therapy, neurology and psychiatry. Demonstration exercises with lifelike instruments teach blood sampling, infusion therapy and patient examination. Graduates can move to a 1.5-year master's leading to advanced practice roles in intensive, emergency, primary or gerontological care.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but the Faculty still tests your English by online test or interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, B2 English and a motivation letter are assessed; the Faculty of Health Sciences also tests English by online test or interview.

programmes.name: Midwifery
programmes.about: Four-year midwifery degree in English supporting women through pregnancy, childbirth and the postpartum period, practice-oriented with clinical placements.
programmes.overview: The four-year course trains midwives to support women through pregnancy, childbirth and the postpartum period. It is practice-oriented, using modern demonstration devices in teaching and including clinical practice. The qualification is accepted automatically across the European Union, and prior learning can allow some students to complete the degree in a shorter time. The course is run by the Faculty of Health Sciences.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but the Faculty still tests your English by online test or interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, B2 English and a motivation letter are assessed; the Faculty of Health Sciences also tests English by online test or interview.

programmes.name: Dietetics
programmes.about: Four-year dietetics degree in English on food chemistry, nutrition and diet therapy for preventing and treating disease.
programmes.overview: You study clinical dietetics for internal medicine, dietetics of infancy and childhood diseases, nutrition management, food chemistry, biochemistry, food technology, practical dietetics, public nutrition, nutrition psychology and nutritional epidemiology, plus the economics of foodservice operations. Specialised clinical areas such as surgical clinical dietetics are included. The course prepares graduates to support patients with weight-related diseases and to manage their diet.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but the Faculty still tests your English by online test or interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, B2 English and a motivation letter are assessed; the Faculty of Health Sciences also tests English by online test or interview.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: Four-year physiotherapy degree in English on movement and exercise therapy, musculoskeletal anatomy and rehabilitation techniques.
programmes.overview: Physiotherapy is presented as much more than massage or exercise advice, aimed at painless movement. After foundation sciences such as anatomy, you study manual techniques, cardio-respiratory physiotherapy, locomotor diseases, neurological and psychiatric physiotherapy, infant and paediatric care, rehabilitation, electro-diagnostics and radiology. Learning moves from the classroom to skill labs and then to practice in the field with a mentor. Graduates can work in healthcare, wellness centres, fitness facilities, spas and sports clubs, or set up a private practice, and doctoral research and teaching are further options.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but the Faculty still tests your English by online test or interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents, B2 English and a motivation letter are assessed; the Faculty of Health Sciences also tests English by online test or interview.

programmes.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Flute)
programmes.about: Three-year classical music BA in English on flute as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.
programmes.overview: Over six semesters you combine lessons on your instrument and performance methodology with orchestral part rehearsal, sight reading, chamber music, choir or orchestra and folk music. Alongside come solfege, music theory, continuo, rhythm practice, Hungarian and world music history, music literature, piano, improvisation, aesthetics and ethics. A diploma concert in the sixth semester concludes the course. Graduates are prepared for orchestras, choirs, chamber ensembles and music institutions, and for master's-level study.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude test (instrument or theory, pass or fail) then a recorded main-subject performance worth up to 200 points (doubled); in person or Skype if called to an oral exam.

family.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance
family.differs: Flute as main instrument; same aptitude test, recording and fee as the other instruments.

programmes.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Guitar)
programmes.about: Three-year classical music BA in English on guitar as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.
programmes.overview: Practical performance and theory are combined over six semesters: lessons on guitar and performance methodology, chamber music, choir or orchestra, folk music, solfege, music theory, music history, improvisation, piano and continuo, along with concert attendance. The repertoire runs from Renaissance to modern styles, including studies and Bach. A diploma concert in the final semester closes the course. Graduates are prepared to work in orchestras, choirs, chamber ensembles and cultural institutions, or to continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude test (instrument or theory, pass or fail) then a recorded main-subject performance worth up to 200 points (doubled); in person or Skype if called to an oral exam.

family.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance
family.differs: Guitar as main instrument; same aptitude test, recording and fee as the other instruments.

programmes.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Piano)
programmes.about: Three-year classical music BA in English on piano as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.
programmes.overview: The six semesters blend instrument lessons and performance methodology with chamber music, folk music, concert attendance, continuo, rhythm practice, improvisation, solfege, music theory, music history and orchestral work. Piano repertoire spans Bach preludes and fugues, classical sonatas, virtuoso studies, Romantic pieces and twentieth-century works. A diploma concert is the final performance assessment. Graduates are prepared for orchestras, choirs, chamber ensembles and cultural institutions, and for master's study in music performance.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude test (instrument or theory, pass or fail) then a recorded main-subject performance worth up to 200 points (doubled); in person or Skype if called to an oral exam.

family.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance
family.differs: Piano as main instrument; same aptitude test, recording and fee as the other instruments.

programmes.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Viola)
programmes.about: Three-year classical music BA in English on viola as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.
programmes.overview: Six semesters mix individual viola lessons and performance methodology with contemporary-style chamber music, orchestra and choir, orchestral part rehearsal and sight reading, and theoretical study in music theory and harmony, solfege, Hungarian and world music history and folk music. Piano is compulsory for students whose main instrument is not piano, and improvisation, continuo, aesthetics and ethics round out the studies. The repertoire includes Bach suites and solo sonatas and concerto movements. A diploma concert closes the course, preparing graduates for orchestras, chamber ensembles, cultural institutions and master's study.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude test (instrument or theory, pass or fail) then a recorded main-subject performance worth up to 200 points (doubled); in person or Skype if called to an oral exam.

family.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance
family.differs: Viola as main instrument; same aptitude test, recording and fee as the other instruments.

programmes.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance (Violin)
programmes.about: Three-year classical music BA in English on violin as your main subject, with music theory, chamber music and orchestral training for ensembles and solo careers.
programmes.overview: The course joins practical performance with theory: main-subject lessons in performance methodology, chamber music, orchestral part rehearsal, choir and orchestra, together with music theory, solfege, music history and aesthetics, plus piano, continuo, rhythm practice, sight reading and improvisation. The violin is the specialised instrument, and a diploma concert in the sixth semester is the capstone. Graduates are prepared for orchestras, choirs, chamber ensembles and music institutions, and for master's-level study.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude test (instrument or theory, pass or fail) then a recorded main-subject performance worth up to 200 points (doubled); in person or Skype if called to an oral exam.

family.name: Classical Instrumental Music Performance
family.differs: Violin as main instrument; same aptitude test, recording and fee as the other instruments.

programmes.name: Classical Music Singing
programmes.about: Three-year classical singing BA in English with voice as your main subject alongside music theory, folk music and music literature.
programmes.overview: The course has a pedagogical orientation, preparing singers for a teaching role as well as for performance. Studies cover voice training, chamber music, choir or orchestra, voice health, solfege, music theory, music history and literature, a foreign language for singers, piano, folk music and repertoire studies with a rehearsal pianist. Pedagogical subjects include professional methodology, the teaching profession, social psychology and ethics. You perform baroque, classical, romantic, twentieth and twenty-first century and folk song repertoire in several languages, and finish with a diploma concert.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude test (instrument or theory, pass or fail) then a recorded main-subject performance worth up to 200 points (doubled); in person or Skype if called to an oral exam.

programmes.name: Orchestral and Choral Conducting
programmes.about: Three-year degree in English training conductors for orchestras and choirs, combining conducting with vocal studies and theory.
programmes.overview: Foundation courses in philosophy, aesthetics, art history, music history and acoustics sit alongside solfege, piano, chamber music, chamber singing and conducting technique and style. Rehearsal work is central, with conducting practice on orchestral scores such as Mozart's Eine kleine Nachtmusik and Schubert's Unfinished Symphony and on choral repertoire, and a final semester with a rehearsal pianist and a diploma choir. Choral conducting is combined with vocal studies. Graduates work in musical institutions, professional ensembles and other occupations that need music education.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma exempts from the English test, but a live audition-style entrance exam (aptitude test plus recorded performance) decides.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry through the Faculty of Arts' music entrance exam: aptitude test plus a practical main-subject exam.

programmes.name: Electronic Music and Media Art
programmes.about: Three-year BA in English on electronic music, video art and new media, built on philosophy, contemporary aesthetics, network laws and art history.
programmes.overview: Theory subjects include philosophy, contemporary aesthetics, art and music history, acoustics, music theory, psychoacoustics and electronic music notation, while the specialised side covers composition practice, sound synthesis and analysis, timbre solfege and MaxMSP programming. Studio practice and computer music projects run through all six semesters, with concert practice, and fine arts and classical music students collaborate in projects that have been running since 1996. Areas include electronic composition, media performance, sound design and network art, with free-chosen topics later on, and the course ends with diploma work.
programmes.ib: Application material and an oral exam if called decide; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: The admissions committee reviews your application material and may call you to an in-person or Skype oral exam.

programmes.name: Designer Making: Ceramics Design
programmes.about: Three-year studio-based design BA in English combining design, material research, 3D design and 3D printing, on the Zsolnay Cultural Quarter campus.
programmes.overview: Teaching is studio-focused and based in the Zsolnay Cultural Quarter, combining design, material research, 3D design and 3D printing across several materials. Year one brings visual studies, creative design studies and cultural anthropology, then studio ceramics, design methods and design history, followed by art history, industrial product design, 3D modelling, form studies, colour theory and aesthetics. You explore design, craftsmanship, autonomous art and contemporary architecture before specialising, and academic writing and diploma consultations lead to a diploma work in the last semester.
programmes.ib: Application material and an oral exam if called decide; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: The Faculty of Arts committee reviews your material and may call you to an in-person or Skype oral exam.

family.name: Designer Making (BA)
family.differs: Ceramics and material-based design in the Zsolnay Cultural Quarter studios.

programmes.name: Designer Making: Fashion and Textiles Design
programmes.about: Three-year design BA in English with a fashion and textile design specialisation built around contemporary tapestry art, taught in the Design and Media Art Department.
programmes.overview: The specialism is contemporary tapestry art, taught in a workshop where each student has an individual loom and all materials and tools. Design and workshop work in tapestry and art history run through every semester, alongside the history of textiles, textile colouring, 3D modelling and digital photography; later semesters add sociology, philosophy, scientific writing and professional presentation. You grow from beginner to independent textile artist, with summer internships, university-wide electives and several platforms for showing your work. The final diploma project is an independent body of work, and graduates can continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: Application material and an oral exam if called decide; IB Diploma exempts from the English test only.
programmes.selectionNote: The Faculty of Arts committee reviews your material and may call you to an in-person or Skype oral exam.

family.name: Designer Making (BA)
family.differs: Fashion and textile design, centred on contemporary tapestry art.

notes: Humanities programmes and Business Administration list a lower EU rate (for example €1,150 against €2,750 a semester in business); science, health and arts programmes list one price for everyone.
Medical School direct applicants sit a live online entrance exam, any Wednesday from 3 March to 14 July 2027 (USD 250), and its page states an IB Diploma does not exempt you.
Mathematics, Electrical Engineering and Midwifery appear on the apply portal for 2027/28 but not on the international study-programs list, so check them with the International Centre.
